_note: Batch 5: ten REAL Perth natural & alternative therapy practices researched from public information on 8 Aug 2026. Introduces the 'natural' practice category (created on import) covering naturopathy, herbal medicine, homeopathy, Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ayurveda and acupuncture. Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings. Copy is strictly factual — services, registrations, prices and hours only, no therapeutic or outcome claims. Per-listing confirmation notes in _source.

categories.name: Meditation classes
categories.blurb: Drop-in sittings, guided courses and beginner-friendly evening classes.

categories.name: Breathwork
categories.blurb: Conscious connected breathing, pranayama and nervous-system reset work.

categories.name: Yoga & movement
categories.blurb: Yin, hatha, restorative and slow-flow studios with a mindfulness focus.

categories.name: Mindfulness coaching
categories.blurb: One-to-one coaching, MBSR courses and workplace mindfulness programs.

categories.name: Sound & float
categories.blurb: Sound baths, gong journeys, float tanks and sensory recovery rooms.

categories.name: Retreats & day escapes
categories.blurb: Half-day resets through to weekend retreats within a drive of Perth.

categories.name: Dietitians & nutrition
categories.blurb: Accredited practising dietitians and nutrition support, in clinic and by telehealth.

categories.name: Bodywork & Massage
categories.blurb: Remedial, sports and relaxation massage, lymphatic drainage, Bowen and hands-on therapies.

categories.name: Natural & Alternative Therapies
categories.blurb: Naturopaths, herbalists, homeopaths, Chinese medicine, Ayurveda and acupuncture.

listings.name: Perth Naturopathic & Herbal Clinic
listings.blurb: Running since 1992, this Edward Street clinic brings eight practitioners together across naturopathy, herbal medicine, homeopathy, iridology, reflexology and hypnotherapy. Herbal formulas are compounded on site from European, Western, Chinese and Ayurvedic traditions, with functional testing — gut and DNA panels included — available through the clinic.
listings._source: pnhc.com.au — address, phone, email, services, eight practitioners, est. 1992 confirmed; prices and hours not published

listings.name: NatMed Natural Medicine Clinic
listings.blurb: A large George Street clinic with seven naturopaths plus an Ayurvedic practitioner, nutritionist, kinesiologist, chiropractor and nurse practitioner under one roof, with in-house testing. Prices are stated plainly — initial naturopathic consultations from $209, follow-ups from $139, and a free fifteen-minute discovery call to start. Open weeknights to 7pm twice a week.
listings._source: natmed.com.au — address, phone, fees ($209 initial / $139 follow-up / free discovery call), hours, 13 practitioners confirmed

listings.name: Baolin Acupuncture & Chinese Medicine Centre
listings.blurb: Traditional Chinese medicine rooms on Newcastle Street with a second clinic in Subiaco. Three AHPRA-registered practitioners offer acupuncture, Chinese herbal medicine, cupping and remedial massage, and the price list is public: $95 for an initial acupuncture consultation, $75 after that, herbal consultations $50 and cupping $40, with HICAPS rebates on the spot.
listings._source: tcmcentre.com.au — both addresses, phones, email, full price list, hours, three registered practitioners, HICAPS confirmed

listings.name: Lakshmi Ayurveda
listings.blurb: A dedicated Ayurvedic centre in a Fremantle cottage offering consultations, abhyanga oil massage, panchakarma programs and rasayana therapy in the classical Kerala tradition, guided by senior advisor Dr L. Mahadevan. There are yoga classes, a herbal dispensary, courses and a supervised student clinic. Open Monday to Saturday.
listings._source: lakshmiayurveda.com.au — address, phone, services, hours (Mon–Sat 9–4.30) confirmed; prices and email not published

listings.name: Cottesloe Naturopathic Clinic
listings.blurb: Michael Blanch has practised naturopathy for more than thirty-five years from the Napoleon Close Arcade, combining herbal medicine, homeopathy, nutrition and iridology in long-form consultations. Natural fertility support is a focus of the practice, and appointments run in clinic, online or by phone Australia-wide.
listings._source: cottnat.com.au — address, phone, services, 35+ years experience, online/phone formats confirmed; prices, email and hours not published

listings.name: Cambridge Health Centre
listings.blurb: A Wembley Downs practice offering homeopathic and naturopathic consultations alongside herbal medicine, nutrition work, reflexology and food-sensitivity testing. Practitioners are registered with the Australian Register of Homeopaths, initial consultations run to an hour or more, and short acute appointments are available for simpler matters.
listings._source: cambridgehealth.com.au — address, phone, services, AROH registration confirmed; prices, email and hours not published

listings.name: Pure Health and Wellness Clinic
listings.blurb: A six-practitioner clinic on Old Perth Road pairing naturopathy and homeopathy with remedial massage, Bowen therapy, reflexology and hypnotherapy. Live blood analysis is offered at a stated $110 for a forty-minute session, and the clinic stays open to 8pm on weeknights with Saturday hours — rare flexibility for the Swan corridor.
listings._source: purehealthandwellness.com.au — address, phone, email, six practitioners, hours (Mon–Fri 9–8, Sat 9–4), $110 live blood analysis confirmed

listings.name: Perth Ayurveda
listings.blurb: Dr Jini, a registered practitioner in the Indian system of medicine practising Ayurveda since 2004, runs this Beckenham clinic offering dosha-based consultations, therapeutic oil massages, herbal preparations and dietary guidance. Bookings are online and HICAPS is accepted, along with most common payment methods.
listings._source: perthayurveda.com.au — address, phone, practitioner background (registered, practising since 2004), online booking, HICAPS confirmed; prices, email and hours not published

listings.name: Nature's Chinese Medicine & Acupuncture Clinic
listings.blurb: Established in 1999, this Belmont clinic is run by two AHPRA-registered Chinese medicine practitioners specialising in Master Tung's acupuncture and the Dr Tan Balance Method, alongside Chinese herbal medicine and TCM health assessments. More than forty private health funds are accepted with on-the-spot HICAPS rebates, and Saturday mornings are open.
listings._source: natureshealth.au — Belmont address (105 Gardiner St), phone, two registered practitioners, est. 1999, hours (Mon–Fri 9–5, Sat 9–12), HICAPS confirmed; prices behind /fees page, email not published

listings.name: Karrinyup Wellness Centre
listings.blurb: A multi-modality centre on Karrinyup Road where two degree-qualified naturopaths offer herbal medicine, homeopathic medicine and nutritional therapy in long-form appointments, with chiropractic, massage and kinesiology in the same rooms. Open from 7.30am six days a week, and no GP referral is needed.
listings._source: wellness-centre.com.au — address, phone, email, services, two naturopaths, hours (Mon–Fri 7.30–6.30, Sat 7.30–2.30) confirmed; prices not published
